newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia PM appoints projects facilitator.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia PM appoints projects facilitator.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard announced on Wednesday the appointment of Bob Mansfield as major projects facilitator in his office.
"Mr Mansfield's role will be to ensure that speedy approvals are given to major nation-building investment proposals which conform with government policy," Howard said in a statement.
The government's major projects facilitation programme was aimed at cutting national and state red tape and streamlining the approvals process for major projects.
Howard said Mansfield would serve as a part-time consultant and his appointment would be for an initial period of 12 months with scope for a further extension.
"Mr Mansfield will enter into early discussions with me on key projects where I believe he can bring his commercial knowledge and experience to bear," he said.
Mansfield is the former chief executive of newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd and recently completed a review of state broadcaster Australian Broadcasting Corp.
